shortDefinition.en: A widely supported rendered-image format that normally uses lossy compression and processed color and tone.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 广泛支持的已呈现图像格式，通常使用有损压缩和已处理的色彩与影调。

en: JPEG is not merely a different extension for the same data as RAW.
zh-cn: JPEG 不是仅把 RAW 数据换了一个扩展名。

example.en: In-camera JPEG processing can choose a picture style, sharpening, and noise reduction before delivery.
example.zh-cn: 机内 JPEG 处理可在交付前选择照片风格、锐化与降噪。

sources.title: JPEG vs. RAW — Adobe
sources.supports: JPEG's rendered-image workflow and lossy-compression trade-offs.
